name: Isla Del Fuego Marathon 2026
short_description: A full marathon and multi-distance race set for September 6, 2026, in Siquijor, Philippines, organized by SMOKE10 Events.
ai_summary: The Isla Del Fuego Marathon 2026 is a full marathon scheduled for September 6, 2026, in Siquijor, Philippines. Organized by SMOKE10 Events, the race takes place along Siquijor Blvd and offers multiple distance options: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km) to suit different runners
Scenic race location along Siquijor Blvd in Siquijor, Philippines
Organized by an established events company, SMOKE10 Events
cons: Registration status has not yet been announced, so sign-up details are unavailable

excerpt_quotes.quote: It was my first official race, my longest run ever—and the most proud I had ever been of my body.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Runner reflecting on the 21K at Isla del Fuego Marathon 2024 (Nov. 17, 2024), Dumaguete MetroPost

excerpt_quotes.quote: Crossing that 21K finish line in Siquijor actually made me feel like a genuine athlete for the first time in years.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Runner reflecting on the 21K at Isla del Fuego Marathon 2024, Dumaguete MetroPost

research_highlights: Event offers 5K, 10K, 21K and 42K distances, starting on Siquijor Blvd / the Siquijor circumferential road
Very early gun starts to beat the heat: 5:00 AM for the 5K, 4:30 AM for the 10K, and 3:00 AM for the 21K
Race is organized by SMOKE10 Events, an operation tied to an NGO (Heartbeat Mission Foundation) rather than a purely commercial promoter
At least one past finisher described the 21K here as their first official race and a proud personal milestone
The event has shifted dates across years (e.g., a November 2024 edition, a planned September 2025 edition), so always confirm the current year's exact date
research_watchouts: Very limited independent participant reviews are publicly available online — the event's own Facebook page shows 'Not yet rated (1 Review)', suggesting a small track record of public feedback
Past editions have moved between different months (March in 2019, November in 2024/2025 announcements, September in other years), so schedule details have changed edition to edition

faqs.question: When is the Isla Del Fuego Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Isla Del Fuego Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 6, 2026. The race will be held in Siquijor, Philippines, along Siquijor Blvd, and includes distance options of 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km for participants to choose from.

faqs.question: Can I register for the Isla Del Fuego Marathon 2026 now?
faqs.answer: As of now, the registration status for the Isla Del Fuego Marathon 2026 has not yet been announced. Prospective participants will need to wait for further details from the organizer, SMOKE10 Events, regarding when and how registration will open for this race.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The Isla Del Fuego Marathon 2026 is held in Siquijor, Philippines, specifically along Siquijor Blvd. This location serves as the venue for all the race distances offered, including the full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km options for participants.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The Isla Del Fuego Marathon 2026 offers four distance options for participants: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a 5km race, allowing runners of varying experience levels to participate.
